name: Rubyfront of the Wandering Wood
summary: The beast of the walking forest: it watches over its Auros in stasis, wakes them and calls them back from the Requiem.

nexusRequirement.label: Nexus requirement
nexusRequirement.text: Control at least 4 Auros Entities and, during this turn, at least one Auros Entity you control was untapped while it was in Stasis. Then send that Entity to your Requiem Zone. That card cannot return to the field for the rest of the game

faceA.name: Rubyfront of the Wandering Wood

keyword.name: Fury
keyword.rules: d20 ≥ 12 before every action · failure −1 HP

effect.name: Memory of the Wood
effect.text: The first time each of your turns an Auros Entity you control is untapped by an effect, you gain 1 HP.

arrival.text: You may untap an Auros Entity you control.

perennialSap.name: Perennial Sap
perennialSap.text: untap an Auros Entity you control.

frondRecall.name: Recall through the Boughs
frondRecall.text: choose an Auros Entity in your Requiem Zone and add it to your hand.

phaseAway.name: Phase Away
phaseAway.text: return an Entity the opponent controls to its owner's hand.

faceA.flavor: You do not find the wood. The wood decides to find you.

faceB.name: Folded Glade

effect.name: Waking of the Glade
effect.text: The first time each of your turns an Auros Entity you control is untapped by an effect, draw a card.

perennialBloom.name: Perennial Bloom
perennialBloom.text: untap up to 2 Auros Entities you control.

foldingTide.name: Folding Tide
foldingTide.text: return up to 2 Entities the opponent controls to their owners' hands.

woodCall.name: Call of the Wood
woodCall.text: put an Auros Entity with Flux cost 3 or less from your Requiem Zone onto your Front.

faceB.flavor: Here space folds upon itself, and what sleeps awakens.
